summary: Mobile IPv6 bootstrapping has a split scenario, where network access and mobility service are authorized by different parties, and an integrated scenario, where one party authorizes both. This RFC defines how a mobile node finds home agent information in the integrated scenario.

eli5.summary: Sometimes one ticket office handles both your bus ride and your hotel. This memo explains how a traveler finds the hotel details when one office does both.

questions: how does mobile ipv6 bootstrapping work in the integrated scenario
how to find a home agent for mobile ipv6
